title: Rhinestone Eyes
lyrics:
[00:10.28]I'm a scary gargoyle on a tower
[00:13.22]That you made with plastic power
[00:16.02]Your rhinestone eyes are like factories far away
[00:20.79]Where the paralytic dreams that we all seem to keep

[00:31.02]So call the mainland from the beach

[01:43.39]I'm a scary gargoyle on a tower
